author: claude-code
choice: glowup adds a $.glowup noun whose methods field, meter and divider are events; a separate Claude Code plugin that depends on glowup hooks them and answers with data (colored text segments; the field as a looping list of frames). glowup plays field frames in its own Client on its own timer and falls back to its own drawing when nothing answers.

evidence.ref: Spike 2026-10-05 with --plugin-dir hostx+guestx on Claude Code 2.1.289: guest hook on hostx.field ran; returning a guest Client failed ('the plugin loaded no surface module'); returning 48 warp frames (48,481 chars of props) played at 83 ms in the host's Client.

rationale: The mod runtime refuses import() and runs mods isolated, so glowup cannot run downloaded code; plugin dependencies are the sanctioned path and Claude Code's /plugin trust covers the code. A Client node a guest returns runs as the plugin that renders the tree, so animation has to cross as frames, not as the guest's Client.
text: Packs get custom drawing through renderer plugins that hook glowup.field, glowup.meter and glowup.divider

author: claude-code
rationale: process.run reads output until exit and kills at 30 s; process.spawn kills its child when the module unloads; process is CLI-only, so the desktop has no way to open a window
cost_if_wrong: Release archives and install docs change
choice: glowup-installer config --run <dir>, launched detached through sh -c 'setsid -f' from process.run; the pane stays for sessions without a terminal surface and as /glowup config pane
alternatives: Remove the pane one release later

text: Each config TUI run has its own directory, and only the session that created it applies its commands
author: claude-code
rationale: Commands build on each session's in-memory state, so several sessions applying one line store different results; one writer keeps the store consistent, and per-run directories remove run ordering and takeover handling
cost_if_wrong: Other open sessions see changes only at their next start
choice: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/glowup/remote/<run>/ holds owner, undo.json, open (mtime heartbeat), commands.jsonl and state.json; a 250 ms poll in the owning session only; commands limited to an allowlist
alternatives: One shared channel every session applies

text: Config TUI undo restores the raw store keys saved at run start and reloads settings
author: claude-code
rationale: In-memory values would pin defaults (a migrated mix, fallback fields, an absent setup) into the store; a file survives a hot reload
choice: undo.json holds mix, pet, bubbles, reducedMotion, setup and statusline as stored (null when absent); undo writes them back, deletes absent keys, and calls loadSettings factored out of session.start
alternatives: Restore in-memory values through the Ctl setters

text: From a mod, process.run of sh -c 'setsid -f konsole -e …' returns in under 1 s and the window survives a module hot reload
author: claude-code

text: When /glowup config cannot use tmux or a terminal named in $TERMINAL or detected by its variable, it opens the person's default terminal
author: claude-code
rationale: The owner asked for default-terminal launch beyond Konsole; xdg-terminal-exec and x-terminal-emulator are the standard default-terminal entry points, and $TERMINAL is an explicit choice so it beats detection
choice: Linux: tmux, then $TERMINAL (any; unknown ones get -e), then the detected current terminal, then xdg-terminal-exec, then x-terminal-emulator, then the printed command. macOS: tmux, Ghostty/Terminal/iTerm by TERM_PROGRAM, else Terminal.app

Read desktop settings (kdeglobals TerminalApplication, gsettings default-applications.terminal)
